title: Prove euf lemmas over folded ites without the unfolded fallback
summary: EUF theory lemmas that reach if-then-else terms are now proved in Lean with the ites folded only, dropping the never-used unfolded fallback under first. The EUF lemmas of register_file_instance(8) shrink from 1.55 MB to 0.71 MB and its Lean check drops from 20 s to 7 s, with theorem statements unchanged.
